# Docs Consistency Workflow

## When to Use
- README 與實際流程不一致
- 文件前後術語不同
- 新人無法按步驟完成 setup

## Procedure
1. Collect source docs and define the target audience.
2. Build a terminology map and detect conflicting definitions.
3. Validate sequence: prerequisites -> setup -> operation -> troubleshooting.
4. Flag contradictions and ambiguous statements.
5. Run [Documentation Consistency Checklist](./references/checklist.md) and record results.
6. Rewrite only necessary sections; keep project wording style.
7. Produce the final report using [Review Report Template](./assets/review-report-template.md).

## Output Contract
- Findings by severity
- Exact replacement text
- Remaining assumptions
- Checklist result summary (pass/fail per section)
- Must follow [Review Report Template](./assets/review-report-template.md)
